verdict.rationale: Zero's own README promises 'Self-Hosting Freedom' and documents a local setup path (env bootstrap, devcontainer, `pnpm go` starting the database and dev servers), so the app itself can be self-hosted. However, the mail pipeline still runs through external providers such as Gmail (Google OAuth required), and 'Self-hosting capabilities' still appears on the roadmap. missing for 10: evidence of a fully self-controlled mail pipeline (own SMTP/IMAP or no third-party provider dependency), dedicated self-hosting/deployment docs, independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted install.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control

citations.quote: Self-Hosting Freedom – Run your own email app with ease.
gives users the power to self-host their own email app while also integrating external services like Gmail and other email providers
